units.title: OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH AND SAFETY IN COMPUTER NETWORKING

learning_outcomes.description: The importance of occupational health and safety in computer networking

performance_criteria.description: Explain relevant occupational health and safety regulations in the network industry.
Explain the importance of following occupational health and safety to prevent accidents, electrical hazards, and ensure personal and team safety.
Describe the consequences of non- compliance with occupational health and safety in network installation projects.

learning_outcomes.description: Recognize potential hazards in the network installation environment

performance_criteria.description: Identify common hazards in network environments, such as electrical risks, tripping hazards, and sharp tools.
Assess risks in a work area before beginning tasks to ensure safety.
Recommend appropriate mitigation strategies to reduce hazards during network installation.

learning_outcomes.description: Use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for networking tasks

performance_criteria.description: Identify the correct PPE required for network tasks (e.g., safety gloves, safety glasses, hard hats).
Demonstrate the correct use of PPE to ensure personal safety during installation and maintenance.
Inspect PPE before use to ensure it is in good condition and meets safety requirements.

learning_outcomes.description: Follow safe work practices during network installation

performance_criteria.description: Apply lockout/tagout procedures to electrical systems to prevent electrical shock during cabling tasks.
Safely handle tools, such as cable cutters, strippers, and crimpers, following safety procedures.
Maintain a clean and organized work area to reduce the risk of accidents and ensure safe movement around the installation site.

learning_outcomes.description: Dispose of materials and equipment

performance_criteria.description: Identify the proper disposal methods for materials used in network cabling (e.g., cables, insulation, packaging).
Safely store and dispose of hazardous materials, such as batteries or chemicals, following environmental safety regulations.
Demonstrate the ability to clean up after installation tasks while adhering to environmental occupational health and safety.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the role of teamwork in network installation projects

performance_criteria.description: Explain the importance of teamwork in completing network installation tasks efficiently and on time.
Identify individual roles and responsibilities within a team during a network installation project.
Describe how effective teamwork contributes to safety and quality in network installation processes.

learning_outcomes.description: Collaborate effectively with team members on network tasks

performance_criteria.description: Communicate task objectives and responsibilities clearly with team members to ensure mutual understanding.
Assist other team members in completing tasks to maintain project flow.
Resolve conflicts or disagreements with team members constructively, without disrupting project progress.

learning_outcomes.description: Follow supervisory guidance and instructions during network installations

performance_criteria.description: Interpret instructions from supervisors or team leads accurately to ensure compliance with project requirements.
Demonstrate the ability to ask for clarification when instructions or tasks are not fully understood.
Execute tasks according to the supervisory plan, adjusting to changes in instruction as needed.

learning_outcomes.description: Manage tasks and time effectively within a team environment

performance_criteria.description: Prioritize tasks based on project timelines and team objectives.
Monitor task progress and adjust work pace to ensure deadlines are met without compromising quality.
Coordinate with team members to ensure seamless task handovers and continuity of work.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate a positive attitude and work ethics  in a team setting

performance_criteria.description: Show respect for diverse team members by valuing their input and contributions.
Maintain a positive attitude, even in challenging situations, to foster a supportive team environment.
Uphold professional standards by being punctual, reliable, and committed to delivering high-quality work.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the importance of communication in network projects

performance_criteria.description: Explain why clear and effective communication is essential in coordinating tasks within network projects.
Identify potential consequences of poor communication in network installation and maintenance activities.
Recognize the role of communication in ensuring safety, efficiency, and adherence to project specifications.

learning_outcomes.description: Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate the ability to listen actively and follow verbal and written instructions from supervisors.
Use appropriate technical terminology when discussing project tasks with team members and supervisors.
Provide clear and concise updates on task progress, challenges, or delays to supervisors in a timely manner.

learning_outcomes.description: Write clear and accurate reports and documentation

performance_criteria.description: Draft task reports that accurately reflect the status of networking, including completed tasks and any issues encountered.
Ensure documentation is organized, legible, and free from errors, following standard formats for technical reporting.
Submit reports and documentation on time, as required by the project or supervisor.

learning_outcomes.description: Know professional communication with clients or stakeholders

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate polite and professional communication skills when interacting with clients or stakeholders on-site.
Explain technical information or project status to clients in clear, non-technical language.
Handle client inquiries or concerns with a positive attitude, escalating issues to supervisors when necessary.

learning_outcomes.description: Use digital communication  tools effectively in networking projects

performance_criteria.description: Use email, messaging apps, and other digital tools to communicate project updates or instructions.
Ensure messages sent through digital tools are clear, concise, and professional.
Follow proper protocols for documenting and storing digital communication related to networking projects.

learning_outcomes.description: Identify Common Network Problems

performance_criteria.description: Identify common symptoms of network issues.
Differentiate between hardware-related, software-related network problems.
Recognize issues related to incorrect IP settings, such as misconfigured IP addresses or subnet masks.
Identify external factors influencing network performance, such as bandwidth congestion or interference in wireless networks.

learning_outcomes.description: Apply Network Troubleshooting Methodology

performance_criteria.description: Apply the troubleshooting methodology (Identify, Test, Resolve, Verify) to diagnose network issues.
Use logical steps to isolate the problem (e.g., check physical connections, verify configurations, test with different devices).
Document the troubleshooting process and solutions to maintain accurate records of network issues.
Resolve network issues efficiently by implementing practical solutions based on troubleshooting steps.

learning_outcomes.description: Use Diagnostic Tools for Network Troubleshooting

performance_criteria.description: Use the "ping" command to check connectivity and packet loss between devices on the same network or across the internet.
Use "tracert" or "traceroute" to diagnose network routing problems and identify where packets are being delayed or dropped.
Use "nslookup" to verify DNS resolution and troubleshoot domain name-related issues.
Use "ipconfig" or "ifconfig" to check IP configuration details.
